say:0:1010201001:0.text: Hang on. Something's off about this place.
say:0:1010201001:0.source_cn: 等一下，这里的气息不对劲。
say:0:1010201001:0.male: Hang on. Something's off about this place.
say:0:1010201001:0.female: Hang on. Something's off about this place.

say:1:1010201002:0.text: There's some weird magic in the air. Feels heavy and oppressive...
say:1:1010201002:0.source_cn: 空气中流动的魔力好诡异，沉重又压抑……

say:2:1010201003:0.text:
It's that serious...?
Let's take a look around the village.
say:2:1010201003:0.source_cn: 这么严重吗……\n我们去村子里调查一圈好了。

say:2:1010202001:0.text: No... These baskets of Gemvine are the wrong weight!
say:2:1010202001:0.source_cn: 不对……这几筐藤水晶的重量不对！

say:3:1010202002:0.text: I told you Lord Franz is personally coming to inspect the village. I won't be able to protect you if he finds that people are secretly eating or hiding the produce!
say:3:1010202002:0.source_cn: 我告诉你们，弗朗茨老爷正亲自在村里视察。要是被他发现有...

say:4:1010202003:0.text: What...? Lord Franz is coming himself?
say:4:1010202003:0.source_cn: 什么……弗朗茨老爷竟然亲自来了？

choice_prompt:5:1010202003.text: What...? Lord Franz is coming himself?
choice_prompt:5:1010202003.source_cn: 什么……弗朗茨老爷竟然亲自来了？

say:6:1010202004:0.text: Who are you...? Don't go asking what shouldn't be asked!
say:6:1010202004:0.source_cn: 你是谁……外乡人，不该问的不要问！

say:7:1010202006:0.text: Wait a minute... You're not Lord Franz's spy, are you?
say:7:1010202006:0.source_cn: 等等……你不会是弗朗茨老爷的眼线吧？！
say:7:1010202006:0.male: Wait a minute... You're not Lord Franz's spy, are you?
say:7:1010202006:0.female: Wait a minute... You're not Lord Franz's spy, are you?

choice_prompt:8:1010202006.text: Wait a minute... You're not Lord Franz's spy, are you?
choice_prompt:8:1010202006.source_cn: 等等……你不会是弗朗茨先生的眼线吧？！
choice_prompt:8:1010202006.male: Wait a minute... You're not Lord Franz's spy, are you?
choice_prompt:8:1010202006.female: Wait a minute... You're not Lord Franz's spy, are you?

say:9:1010202007:0.text: Yeah, Lord Franz's spies wouldn't just be wandering around the village doing nothing.
say:9:1010202007:0.source_cn: 哼，我就说，弗朗茨老爷的眼线才不会在村里到处闲逛。

say:11:1010202008:0.text: Wh-What...? I'll make up for the missing grapes! Please don't tell Lord Franz!
say:11:1010202008:0.source_cn: 什……什么……？！我这就把缺少的斤两追缴回来，您可千万...

choice:5:0:1.text: If he finds out, what then?
choice:5:0:1.male: If he finds out, what then?
choice:5:0:1.female: If he finds out, what then?

say:12:1010202005:0.text: All Gemvine grapes belong to Lord Franz! They're worth more than gold!
say:12:1010202005:0.source_cn: 所有藤水晶都是弗朗茨老爷的私产，比金子还贵重！

say:1:1010203001:0.text:
...A mage wearing a hat with a family through the sewer grates...
...A tattered robe he never washes, but he's always eating grapes...
say:1:1010203001:0.source_cn: 魔法师~戴高帽~他家住在下水道~\n破长袍~不洗澡~却...

choice_prompt:2:1010203001.text:
...A mage wearing a hat with a family through the sewer grates...
...A tattered robe he never washes, but he's always eating grapes...
choice_prompt:2:1010203001.source_cn: 魔法师~戴高帽~他家住在下水道~\n破长袍~不洗澡~却有葡萄吃到饱~

say:3:1010203002:0.text: ...Ding, ding, ding, this ain't so swell! His lordship beat him, made him yell...
say:3:1010203002:0.source_cn: 铃铃铃~不太妙！老爷打他嗷嗷叫！

say:5:1010203003:0.text:
Song? No, no... I'm not singing. This is a poem!
Dedicated to Lord Franz and these wonderful Gemvine grapes!
say:5:1010203003:0.source_cn: 歌？不不不……我没在唱歌，这是一首诗！\n献给弗朗茨老...

say:6:1010203004:0.text:
How can that be?! I'm such a good boy, the most obedient of them all...
I'll never say that I secretly ate two bunches... maybe three?
say:6:1010203004:0.source_cn: 怎么可能！我是乖孩子，最听话了……\n我绝对不会说我偷...

say:2:1010204001:0.text: With everything that's been happening recently, can't you just be good and stay in the village?
say:2:1010204001:0.source_cn: 最近这么多变数，你就不能乖乖待在村子里吗！

say:3:1010204002:0.text: No! Malcolm said the lake's frozen over. I have to go see it! You may not care, Grandpa, but I've never seen a frozen lake.
say:3:1010204002:0.source_cn: 我不！马尔科姆他们说映湖结冰了，我一定要去看看！爷爷你...

say:4:1010204003:0.text:
You don't understand anything!
That just means it's cold, and what's so good about that?
say:4:1010204003:0.source_cn: 你什么都不懂！\n结冰意味着降温，寒冷有什么好？

say:5:1010204004:0.text: Those Northville folks refuse to listen to Lord Franz's advice, and even Merlin's magic can't protect them anymore. I forbid you from going to Northville!
say:5:1010204004:0.source_cn: 北边那群人不肯听弗朗茨老爷的劝告，梅林大人的魔法已经不...
say:5:1010204004:0.male: Those Northville folks refuse to listen to Lord Franz's advice, and even Merlin's magic can't protect them anymore. I forbid you from going to Northville!
say:5:1010204004:0.female: Those Northville folks refuse to listen to Lord Franz's advice, and even Merlin's magic can't protect them anymore. I forbid you from going to Northville!

say:2:1010205001:0.text: Thank goodness! If you hadn't saved me, I'd already be digesting in their bellies!
say:2:1010205001:0.source_cn: 谢天谢地，要不是你们救我，我已经进了它们的肚子！

say:3:1010205002:0.text: Let me introduce myself... My name is Lorsan.
say:3:1010205002:0.source_cn: 自、自我介绍一下……我叫洛桑。

say:4:1010205003:0.text: Hang on, Lorsan... are you saying they were about to eat you?
say:4:1010205003:0.source_cn: 等等……洛桑大人，您是说，您差点被它们吃掉？

say:5:1010205004:0.text: Absolutely! They were even sharpening their knives!
say:5:1010205004:0.source_cn: 千真万确！它们连剥皮的刀都磨好了！

say:6:1010205005:0.text: Gruglins are carnivores. Their diet only consists of herbivores smaller than themselves.
say:6:1010205005:0.source_cn: 咕布林虽然是肉食性类人生物，但它们的食谱上，只有那些体...

say:7:1010205006:0.text:
You clearly only fit one of their criteria, Lorsan.
There has to be a reason for their abnormal behavior.
say:7:1010205006:0.source_cn: 很显然，洛桑大人您只符合其中一条。\n事出反常，必有因。

say:9:1010205007:0.text:
How about we show some concern for the innocent little rabbit here?
After such a long journey, I haven't even had a drink...
say:9:1010205007:0.source_cn: 思考的同时可怜可怜无辜的兔子吧。\n一路旅行到这里，连...

say:10:1010205008:0.text: Hang on, look at all the grapes here! A few of these would do!
say:10:1010205008:0.source_cn: 等等，这里有好多葡萄！看起来很适合解渴！

say:13:1010205010:0.text:
Nom nom nom... They're so sweet!
These are amazing!
say:13:1010205010:0.source_cn: 啊呜啊呜……真甜呐！\n这也太好吃了！

say:14:1010205011:0.text:
Oh...
Something's not right. My stomach... it hurts!
say:14:1010205011:0.source_cn: 唔……\n有点不对劲，肚子……突然好痛！

narration:19:1010205013:0.text: Lorsan falls to the ground, clutching his stomach. Everyone quickly runs over to help him up.

say:23:1010205015:0.text: Uh, you tell me... Is this poor bunny gonna live?
say:23:1010205015:0.source_cn: 呃呜，告诉我……我这只命途多舛的兔子还活着吗？

say:24:1010205016:0.text: He's in fair condition, but most likely some type of poison. Initial symptom was fainting. His complexion is presently rosy...
say:24:1010205016:0.source_cn: 身体情况尚可，但疑似中毒。前兆症状是疼痛至晕厥，目前脸...

choice_prompt:25:1010205016.text: He's in fair condition, but most likely some type of poison. Initial symptom was fainting. His complexion is presently rosy...
choice_prompt:25:1010205016.source_cn: 身体情况尚可，但疑似中毒。前兆症状是疼痛至晕厥，目前脸色红润，生理指标——

say:26:1010205017:0.text: Such a quick reaction. Are you sure it's not fake?
say:26:1010205017:0.source_cn: 这么快有反应，不会是装的吧？

say:27:1010205018:0.text: Unconfirmed. Could be related to your constitution. This requires further study.
say:27:1010205018:0.source_cn: 不确定，有可能和他的体质有关，需要进一步研究。

say:28:1010205019:0.text:
We need to investigate this more closely.
Please sir, could you give us a bunch as a research specimen?
say:28:1010205019:0.source_cn: 有必要进行更细致的调查。\n请问这位先生，能给我一串葡...

say:32:1010205021:0.text: Lord Franz, why don't you eat a bunch right here and prove it's okay?
say:32:1010205021:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨老爷，要不你就在这里吃一串给我们看看，证明它没问题？

say:33:1010205022:0.text: Ridiculous! I'm under no obligation to prove anything to you!
say:33:1010205022:0.source_cn: 可笑，我没有义务向你们证明！

say:34:1010205023:0.text: Lord Franz, I swear it's just for research. Once we have the results, I'll make a special mention of you in my thesis.
say:34:1010205023:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨先生，我保证只是进行研究。一旦出了成果，我会在论...

say:35:1010205024:0.text: Someone! Get these gibbering lunatics out of my sight!
say:35:1010205024:0.source_cn: 来人！把这些胡言乱语的疯子给我赶出去！

say:3:1010208001:0.text: Here we go, everyone. A freshly brewed magical potion courtesy of the magister! Drink up, and you'll be cured!
say:3:1010208001:0.source_cn: 来啦，这可是主人专门为大家熬制的魔药，请满怀感激地一饮...
say:3:1010208001:0.male: Here we go, everyone. A freshly brewed magical potion courtesy of the magister! Drink up, and you'll be cured!
say:3:1010208001:0.female: Here we go, everyone. A freshly brewed magical potion courtesy of the magister! Drink up, and you'll be cured!

say:4:1010208002:0.text: Oh, that's awful... My tongue is numb for some reason.

say:5:1010208003:0.text: But even so, my head does feel a lot clearer. <style="highlight">Misarte</style> above... I think I can actually make it back to the Dark Forest!
say:5:1010208003:0.source_cn: 虽然舌头麻了，脑子却清楚了不少。弥萨忒在上……我总算能...

say:6:1010208004:0.text: This is the first time I've ever encountered this kind of potion. You truly are amazing, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:6:1010208004:0.source_cn: 竟然还有这样的魔药配方，我第一次见。<style=st...
say:6:1010208004:0.male: This is the first time I've ever encountered this kind of potion. You truly are amazing, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:6:1010208004:0.female: This is the first time I've ever encountered this kind of potion. You truly are amazing, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:7:1010208005:0.text: There are so many formulas, recipes, and spells to learn out here in the world... I knew it was the right decision to leave the Lyceum and follow in the footsteps of the great Merlin!
say:7:1010208005:0.source_cn: 世上还有许多我不知道的配方与术式……我选择追随梅林大人...
say:7:1010208005:0.male: There are so many formulas, recipes, and spells to learn out here in the world... I knew it was the right decision to leave the Lyceum and follow in the footsteps of the great Merlin!
say:7:1010208005:0.female: There are so many formulas, recipes, and spells to learn out here in the world... I knew it was the right decision to leave the Lyceum and follow in the footsteps of the great Merlin!

say:8:1010208006:0.text: You're following in Merlin's footsteps, you say? Miss Cassadee, did you, by any chance, come to Ryeham just to study Merlin's ward?
say:8:1010208006:0.source_cn: 追随梅林？科丝蒂小姐，难道，你是为了研究梅林的加护才来...
say:8:1010208006:0.male: You're following in Merlin's footsteps, you say? Miss Cassadee, did you, by any chance, come to Ryeham just to study Merlin's ward?
say:8:1010208006:0.female: You're following in Merlin's footsteps, you say? Miss Cassadee, did you, by any chance, come to Ryeham just to study Merlin's ward?

say:9:1010208007:0.text: That is correct, Hammie. I've been researching Merlin's spells and methods for some time now.
say:9:1010208007:0.source_cn: 是的，漫漫大人，我一直在研究梅林的术式。
say:9:1010208007:0.male: That is correct, Hammie. I've been researching Merlin's spells and methods for some time now.
say:9:1010208007:0.female: That is correct, Hammie. I've been researching Merlin's spells and methods for some time now.

say:10:1010208008:0.text: I heard that Merlin once created a ward so powerful that he was able to make Ryeham, which was once barren, into a bountiful haven for its people.
say:10:1010208008:0.source_cn: 听说，梅林大人曾在此地设下加护。<male>他</ma...
say:10:1010208008:0.male: I heard that Merlin once created a ward so powerful that he was able to make Ryeham, which was once barren, into a bountiful haven for its people.
say:10:1010208008:0.female: I heard that Merlin once created a ward so powerful that she was able to make Ryeham, which was once barren, into a bountiful haven for its people.

say:11:1010208009:0.text:
I came here with the express purpose of locating and studying this magical ward.
His magic can only be described as a work of art. Every spell is meticulous, seamless, and perfect in every way!
say:11:1010208009:0.source_cn: 为了研究梅林大人的加护，我专程来到此地。\n<male...
say:11:1010208009:0.male:
I came here with the express purpose of locating and studying this magical ward.
His magic can only be described as a work of art. Every spell is meticulous, seamless, and perfect in every way!
say:11:1010208009:0.female:
I came here with the express purpose of locating and studying this magical ward.
Her magic can only be described as a work of art. Every spell is meticulous, seamless, and perfect in every way!

say:12:1010208010:0.text: Yes, yes, yes! I totally agree!
say:12:1010208010:0.source_cn: 我懂我懂我懂！我完全理解！

say:13:1010208011:0.text: Really? I'm so glad to meet a familiar with such discerning taste, Hammie!
say:13:1010208011:0.source_cn: 漫漫大人，能和你这样有品味的使魔相遇，我实在是太开心了！

say:14:1010208012:0.text: You as well, Magister. As a scholarly mage yourself, surely you must understand my enthusiasm.
say:14:1010208012:0.source_cn: 您的主人也是一位魔法师，一定能理解我的喜悦！
say:14:1010208012:0.male: You as well, Magister. As a scholarly mage yourself, surely you must understand my enthusiasm.
say:14:1010208012:0.female: You as well, Magister. As a scholarly mage yourself, surely you must understand my enthusiasm.

choice_prompt:15:1010208012.text: You as well, Magister. As a scholarly mage yourself, surely you must understand my enthusiasm.
choice_prompt:15:1010208012.source_cn: 尊敬的<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，您也是一位魔法师，一定理解我的喜悦！
choice_prompt:15:1010208012.male: You as well, Magister. As a scholarly mage yourself, surely you must understand my enthusiasm.
choice_prompt:15:1010208012.female: You as well, Magister. As a scholarly mage yourself, surely you must understand my enthusiasm.

say:16:1010208013:0.text: I see... I suppose there are those who refuse to acknowledge the greatness of Merlin.
say:16:1010208013:0.source_cn: 好吧……的确有魔法师并不认可梅林。
say:16:1010208013:0.male: I see... I suppose there are those who refuse to acknowledge the greatness of Merlin.
say:16:1010208013:0.female: I see... I suppose there are those who refuse to acknowledge the greatness of Merlin.

say:17:1010208014:0.text:
Mages who are indifferent to his extraordinary achievements...
...I simply have nothing to say to them.
say:17:1010208014:0.source_cn: 能在梅林的非凡成就前无动于衷的人……\n我对他们没什么...
say:17:1010208014:0.male:
Mages who are indifferent to his extraordinary achievements...
...I simply have nothing to say to them.
say:17:1010208014:0.female:
Mages who are indifferent to her extraordinary achievements...
...I simply have nothing to say to them.

say:18:1010208016:0.text: Oh... Apologies. Did I come off as too excited just now? It's just that Merlin has always been my guiding star since I started studying magic. A mentor whom I've never met.
say:18:1010208016:0.source_cn: 哦……抱歉。我刚刚是不是太激动了？\n梅林是我在魔法研...
say:18:1010208016:0.male: Oh... Apologies. Did I come off as too excited just now? It's just that Merlin has always been my guiding star since I started studying magic. A mentor whom I've never met.
say:18:1010208016:0.female: Oh... Apologies. Did I come off as too excited just now? It's just that Merlin has always been my guiding star since I started studying magic. A mentor whom I've never met.

say:19:1010208017:0.text: In any case, I'm certain that my understanding of magic will reach even greater heights once I get the chance to analyze his ward!
say:19:1010208017:0.male: In any case, I'm certain that my understanding of magic will reach even greater heights once I get the chance to analyze his ward!
say:19:1010208017:0.female: In any case, I'm certain that my understanding of magic will reach even greater heights once I get the chance to analyze her ward!

say:20:1010208018:0.text: However, there's something strange about the magic in the land surrounding Southville. Something really discomforting...
say:20:1010208018:0.source_cn: 但是南村附近的魔法脉动很诡异，让人不舒服……

say:21:1010208019:0.text: Merlin's magic usually feels so warm and pure... It's nothing like the magic in these parts.
say:21:1010208019:0.source_cn: 梅林的魔法基质向来清澈、温暖，绝不可能是那种奇怪的东西。
say:21:1010208019:0.male: Merlin's magic usually feels so warm and pure... It's nothing like the magic in these parts.
say:21:1010208019:0.female: Merlin's magic usually feels so warm and pure... It's nothing like the magic in these parts.

say:22:1010208020:0.text: Which is why I've decided to head north and investigate.
say:22:1010208020:0.source_cn: 因此，接下来我打算去北边看看。

say:23:1010208021:0.text: It was nice meeting you all today! I must be leaving now, but I hope we will meet again someday!
say:23:1010208021:0.source_cn: 今天很高兴认识各位！我先走一步，我们后会有期！

say:28:1010208022:0.text:
Should we also go north and look around?
We were all in a hurry earlier because of the fire. We might've missed something.
say:28:1010208022:0.source_cn: 我们要不要也回北边看看？\n火灾时走的匆忙，没有仔细调...

say:31:1010208024:0.text: I just remembered something. I recognize some of those thugs that Lord Franz hired.
say:31:1010208024:0.source_cn: 我想起来了——刚才弗朗茨唆使的那几个打手里，有几个我曾...

say:32:1010208025:0.text: On the day of the fire, they claimed to be Northville villagers! They refused to do business with me and even gloated when the fire broke out.
say:32:1010208025:0.source_cn: 火灾当天，他们自称是北村的村民！就是他们不愿和我做生意...

say:33:1010208026:0.text: Are you planning to go back to Northville and investigate? Please bring me along. I want to get to the bottom of this, too!
say:33:1010208026:0.source_cn: 你们是不是打算回北村调查？带上我这个合作伙伴吧，我也想...

say:35:1010208015:0.text: I knew you were one of his fans! I think this is the start of a beautiful friendship!
say:35:1010208015:0.source_cn: 果然，你也是梅林的粉丝！真希望以后有机会能多多交流！
say:35:1010208015:0.male: I knew you were one of his fans! I think this is the start of a beautiful friendship!
say:35:1010208015:0.female: I knew you were one of her fans! I think this is the start of a beautiful friendship!

say:0:1010209001:0.text: Rowan should be a huge help! Wait... Are we being followed?
say:0:1010209001:0.source_cn: 主人，有罗万加入，调查一定会更加顺利的！不过……我怎么...
say:0:1010209001:0.male: Rowan should be a huge help! Wait... Are we being followed?
say:0:1010209001:0.female: Rowan should be a huge help! Wait... Are we being followed?

say:1:1010209002:0.text: It's that bunny-eared guy! He's still hanging around!
say:1:1010209002:0.source_cn: 啊！是那个长着兔子耳朵的人！他没有离开！

say:2:1010209003:0.text: This bunny-eared guy has a name, you know! It's Lorsan! Please don't turn me away. I promise I won't cause any trouble!
say:2:1010209003:0.source_cn: 我是洛桑，不是长着兔子耳朵的人！\n请别赶我走……我保...

say:0:1010210001:0.source_cn: 信息调查得差不多了……维伦人呢？

say:1:1010210002:0.text: Chippy just saw him going that way, Magister!
say:1:1010210002:0.source_cn: 主人，我刚刚看到他往那个方向走了！

say:0:1010210101:0.text: Do you all smell something really bad...?
say:0:1010210101:0.source_cn: 呜……你们有没有闻到一股很难闻的味道……

say:1:1010210102:0.text: Yes! Chippy smells something really gross! From that nearby cave...
say:1:1010210102:0.source_cn: 我我我、我也闻到了！好恶心的臭味，是从附近的洞口飘出来的……

say:2:1010210103:0.text: Is that Valen in front of the cave?
say:2:1010210103:0.source_cn: 咦？洞口前面那是不是——维伦？

say:1:1010210201:1.text: You're here. I hope there was no trouble on the road.
say:1:1010210201:1.source_cn: 哦，你们来了。路上没受伤吧？

choice_prompt:2:1010210201.text: You're here. I hope there was no trouble on the road.
choice_prompt:2:1010210201.source_cn: 哦，你们来了。路上没受伤吧？

say:3:1010210202:1.text: I'm looking into the bandits around here. Did you encounter any on your way?
say:3:1010210202:1.source_cn: 在调查附近的盗匪。你们来的路上有没有遇见过？

choice_prompt:4:1010210202.text: I'm looking into the bandits around here. Did you encounter any on your way?
choice_prompt:4:1010210202.source_cn: 在调查附近的盗匪。你们来的路上有没有遇见过？

say:5:1010210203:1.text: I chased them all the way and thought they all retreated. Some of them must've slipped by me.
say:5:1010210203:1.source_cn: 啧，我一路追击过来，还以为他们已经撤退了，没想到还有漏...

say:6:1010210205:1.text: Well, here's the odd thing. The Heroic Order receives several reports a week from Northville, mostly about bandits or gruglins. The villagers were miserable.
say:6:1010210205:1.source_cn: 那么，奇怪的问题来了。我在骑士团的时候，一周内能接到北...

say:7:1010210206:1.text: By comparison, the area around Southville isn't that much better than Northville, if not worse, but the Heroic Order never got any of these reports.
say:7:1010210206:1.source_cn: 相比之下，南村附近的环境不比北村好多少，甚至更加恶劣—...

say:8:1010210207:1.text: Isn't that strange? Around here, gruglins are more aggressive, and bandits are more numerous, but no one reports anything.
say:8:1010210207:1.source_cn: 不蹊跷么？这附近的咕布林攻击性更强，盗匪数量也多，报案...

say:9:1010210208:1.text: Either the gruglins and bandits are so bad that they wiped out all Southville's villagers and left no witnesses, or...
say:9:1010210208:1.source_cn: 要么是盗匪和咕布林太凶恶，对南村村民赶尽杀绝，没有目击...

choice_prompt:10:1010210208.text: Either the gruglins and bandits are so bad that they wiped out all Southville's villagers and left no witnesses, or...
choice_prompt:10:1010210208.source_cn: 要么是盗匪和咕布林太凶恶，对南村村民赶尽杀绝，没有目击记录；要么是……

say:11:1010210209:1.text: Southville follows Lord Franz's orders. They dug up their wheat fields and planted grapes instead. Now, their lives are peaceful. What a coincidence...
say:11:1010210209:1.source_cn: 南村乖乖听从弗朗茨的话，铲掉麦田改种葡萄，于是生活平和...

say:12:1010210210:1.text: The nobility all have their secrets, but Lord Franz's secrets seem just a bit more interesting.
say:12:1010210210:1.source_cn: 贵族们通常都有秘密，不过弗朗茨老爷的秘密好像更有趣一点。

say:14:1010210211:1.text: Sorry to interrupt, Mr. Valen, but can we go talk somewhere else? You do smell the horrible stench coming from the cave, don't you?
say:14:1010210211:1.source_cn: 抱歉打断你们的谈话……维伦先生，我们能换个地方说话吗？...

say:16:1010210213:1.text: So... W-Wait! You don't mean that you want to go in there, do you? That cave smells so bad that it would knock out a gang of gruglins!
say:16:1010210213:1.source_cn: 等、等一下，难道说，你想进去调查吗？！顶着咕布林都能被...

say:17:1010210214:1.text: My dear Miss Hammie, I'm afraid you are right again.
say:17:1010210214:1.source_cn: 非常遗憾，亲爱的使魔小姐，事情恐怕正如你所想。

say:18:1010210215:1.text: Everything points to this cave as the source of the stench and the whereabouts of the bandits. I've come this far already. I need to see it through.
say:18:1010210215:1.source_cn: 这股味道的来源，还有那些盗匪的去处，都指向了这座山洞，...

say:19:1010210216:1.text: Sometimes, it's better to rip off the bandage quickly. Come on, let's hold our noses and march right in.
say:19:1010210216:1.source_cn: 所以，长痛不如短痛，捏着鼻子，进去吧。

say:22:1010210218:1.text: ... If Chippy and Valen are both going inside, then so can I! There's nothing I can't endure for the magister.
say:22:1010210218:1.source_cn: ……满满和维伦都敢进去，我也可以！没什么不能忍受的！
say:22:1010210218:1.male: ... If Chippy and Valen are both going inside, then so can I! There's nothing I can't endure for the magister.
say:22:1010210218:1.female: ... If Chippy and Valen are both going inside, then so can I! There's nothing I can't endure for the magister.

say:25:1010210204:1.source_cn: 可能剩下的闻风而逃了。

choice:2:0:1.text: How did you end up here alone?
choice:2:0:1.male: How did you end up here alone?
choice:2:0:1.female: How did you end up here alone?

say:0:1010210301:0.text: Come on. It's best to see for ourselves. Let's go find out what's inside.
say:0:1010210301:0.source_cn: 来吧，百闻不如一见，进去看看里面到底有什么。

say:1:1010210302:0.source_cn: 呃，虽然如此，我也快要被熏晕过去了……

say:3:1010210401:1.text: Magister, look! These bags all have the same pattern on them!
say:3:1010210401:1.source_cn: 主人，快看，这几个袋子上都有相同的花纹！
say:3:1010210401:1.male: Magister, look! These bags all have the same pattern on them!
say:3:1010210401:1.female: Magister, look! These bags all have the same pattern on them!

say:5:1010210402:1.source_cn: 不对……这不是装饰的花纹，而是家徽！

say:6:1010210403:1.text: Yes, and it's the crest of our cocky friend—Lord Franz.
say:6:1010210403:1.source_cn: 嗯哼，没错，而且是我们盛气凌人的朋友——弗朗茨的家徽。

choice_prompt:8:1010210403.text: Yes, and it's the crest of our cocky friend—Lord Franz.
choice_prompt:8:1010210403.source_cn: 嗯哼，没错，而且是我们盛气凌人的朋友——弗朗茨的家徽。

say:9:1010210404:1.text: Correct. These are money bags that Lord Franz and his estates use to settle their accounts.
say:9:1010210404:1.source_cn: 没错，这就是弗朗茨及名下庄园平时拿来结账的钱袋。

say:10:1010210405:1.text: What are they doing here? Did the bandits rob Lord Franz? Are all of these stolen?
say:10:1010210405:1.source_cn: 那，这些钱袋为什么会在这里？是盗匪们抢劫了弗朗茨吗？这...

say:11:1010210406:1.text: No, if any of his gold was stolen, Lord Franz would be knocking on the doors of the Heroic Order and asking Valen and the other knights to catch these bandits.
say:11:1010210406:1.source_cn: 不对哦，如果是自己的钱被抢了，弗朗茨怎么可能不颐指气使...

choice_prompt:12:1010210406.text: No, if any of his gold was stolen, Lord Franz would be knocking on the doors of the Heroic Order and asking Valen and the other knights to catch these bandits.
choice_prompt:12:1010210406.source_cn: 不对哦，如果是自己的钱被抢了，弗朗茨怎么可能不颐指气使地使唤骑士团，叫维伦他们捉拿盗匪呢。

say:13:1010210407:0.text: ...I think I've got it! The bandits didn't steal the money.
say:13:1010210407:0.source_cn: ……我明白了！这些钱袋并不是盗匪劫掠的赃物。

say:14:1010210408:0.text: Lord Franz must be paying them to leave Southville alone!
say:14:1010210408:0.source_cn: 相反，他们是收了弗朗茨的钱，所以才不去骚扰袭击南村！

say:15:1010210409:1.text: No way! If that's true, then the bandits are being paid by Lord Franz. Wait, you don't think he ordered the attack on Northville?!
say:15:1010210409:1.source_cn: 不、不会吧？！如果真是这样，盗匪们是被弗朗茨雇佣的？！...

say:16:1010210410:1.text: That's gotta be it. He ordered the bandits to leave Southville alone and attack Northville because they weren't giving in to his demands.
say:16:1010210410:1.source_cn: 应该正是如此。反对弗朗茨的北村，他就暗中指使盗匪袭扰，...

say:17:1010210411:1.text: That's why we seldom received reports from Southville.
say:17:1010210411:1.source_cn: 这也是我们很少接到南村报案的原因了。

say:18:1010210412:1.text: However, this is all still speculation. It's a big cave. Let's keep looking for more clues.
say:18:1010210412:1.source_cn: 目前一切都还是推测，这座山洞不小，再找找其他线索吧。

say:2:1010210501:1.text: Look, Magister! A gruglin mask... LOTS of gruglin masks! The smell seems to be coming from over there...
say:2:1010210501:1.source_cn: 主人，看！是咕布林的面具，还有好多个！味道就是从这里散...
say:2:1010210501:1.male: Look, Magister! A gruglin mask... LOTS of gruglin masks! The smell seems to be coming from over there...
say:2:1010210501:1.female: Look, Magister! A gruglin mask... LOTS of gruglin masks! The smell seems to be coming from over there...

say:6:1010210502:1.text: Hmm... Even though they smell like they haven't been washed for a decade, some of the masks have very fine patterns and feel quite well-made.
say:6:1010210502:1.source_cn: 唔……虽然闻起来像是十年没洗的臭衣服，但是有些面具的花...

say:7:1010210503:1.text: Yes, it's a shame some of them are damaged, or they'd have fetched a good price.
say:7:1010210503:1.source_cn: 确实，可惜有些损毁了，否则还能卖个好价钱。

choice_prompt:9:1010210503.text: Yes, it's a shame some of them are damaged, or they'd have fetched a good price.
choice_prompt:9:1010210503.source_cn: 确实，可惜有些损毁了，否则还能卖个好价钱。

say:10:1010210504:1.text: Don't be so surprised. Some collectors or researchers like these kinds of things. But you won't get much for damaged ones.
say:10:1010210504:1.source_cn: 别这么惊讶，有些收藏家或者民俗学者喜欢收集这些奇怪的玩...

say:11:1010210505:1.text: But I've got a strange feeling...
say:11:1010210505:1.source_cn: 不过……我总觉得有些反常。

choice_prompt:12:1010210505.text: But I've got a strange feeling...
choice_prompt:12:1010210505.source_cn: 不过……我总觉得有些反常。

say:13:1010210506:1.text: You know that those bandits like to bully the weak, but they wouldn't have provoked the gruglins for no reason.
say:13:1010210506:1.source_cn: 你要知道，那群盗匪向来欺软怕硬，除非是他们皮痒了，否则...
say:13:1010210506:1.male: You know that those bandits like to bully the weak, but they wouldn't have provoked the gruglins for no reason.
say:13:1010210506:1.female: You know that those bandits like to bully the weak, but they wouldn't have provoked the gruglins for no reason.

say:14:1010210507:1.text: They're no pushovers, after all. Although it's hard to communicate with the gruglins, there are loads of them, and each one is as strong as an ox.
say:14:1010210507:1.source_cn: 毕竟那些咕布林可不好对付，没法沟通，数量又多，还一身蛮力。

say:15:1010210508:1.text: But look at these masks. They can't all be hand-wrapped gifts from the gruglins, right?
say:15:1010210508:1.source_cn: 可你再看看这些咕布林面具，总不能是咕布林打包送来的礼物吧？
say:15:1010210508:1.male: But look at these masks. They can't all be hand-wrapped gifts from the gruglins, right?
say:15:1010210508:1.female: But look at these masks. They can't all be hand-wrapped gifts from the gruglins, right?

say:16:1010210509:1.text: Mr. Valen, didn't you say that, despite so many gruglin camps nearby, there were very few reported attacks in Southville...?
say:16:1010210509:1.source_cn: 维伦先生，你刚才说过，尽管周边咕布林营地众多，但南村却...

say:17:1010210510:1.text: Could Lord Franz have paid the bandits to deal with the local gruglins and keep Southville undisturbed?
say:17:1010210510:1.source_cn: 该不会是弗朗茨付钱给盗匪们，让他们去阻止这附近的咕布林...

say:18:1010210511:1.text: That's it, Miss Hammie! That's the only possible explanation.
say:18:1010210511:1.source_cn: 很聪明嘛。这是唯一可能的解释了，漫漫小姐。

say:19:1010210512:1.text: Hiring mercenaries requires a contract, but by hiring bandits, Lord Franz could deny all accountability and even accuse them of stealing his property.
say:19:1010210512:1.source_cn: 找佣兵还要签订合同，而盗匪就算事后反咬，弗朗茨也能立刻...

say:20:1010210513:1.text: That's actually ingenious. If that's really what he was up to, I might have to change my opinion of him.
say:20:1010210513:1.source_cn: 真是巧妙的算计，如果这些都是那位老爷的计划，那我可要对...

say:0:1010210601:0.text: This stench... Chippy can't stand it!

say:1:1010210602:0.text: Seems like there aren't any other clues. Let's get out of here.
say:1:1010210602:0.source_cn: 似乎也没有别的线索了，赶紧出去吧。

say:0:1010210701:0.text: Isn't that Rowan? What's he doing out here in the middle of nowhere?
say:0:1010210701:0.source_cn: 嗯？那不是罗万小少爷吗？他跑到这荒郊野岭来干什么？

say:2:1010210801:1.text: What a coincidence running into you here, Rowan. How's your business venture going?
say:2:1010210801:1.source_cn: 真巧啊，小少爷，又见面了。你的商业考察计划怎么样了？

say:3:1010210802:1.text: Not great. The Southville villagers won't talk to an outsider about the Gemvine grapes. I've got to think of something else.
say:3:1010210802:1.source_cn: 不算顺利，南村的村民不愿意和外人说藤水晶的收获情况，只...

say:4:1010210803:1.text: When I was looking around, I discovered that the gruglins and bandits are no fewer than in Northville...
say:4:1010210803:1.source_cn: 我在村附近调查的时候，发现咕布林和盗匪完全不比北村少……

say:5:1010210804:1.text: It's strange that Southville still managed to ensure their harvest, even when surrounded by so many enemies...
say:5:1010210804:1.source_cn: 周围群敌环伺，南村竟然能在这种情况下保证作物耕种产出……

choice_prompt:6:1010210804.text: It's strange that Southville still managed to ensure their harvest, even when surrounded by so many enemies...
choice_prompt:6:1010210804.source_cn: 周围群敌环伺，南村竟然能在这种情况下保证作物耕种产出……

say:7:1010210805:1.text: It might stink in there, but it's not dangerous. Lord Franz and the bandits may have colluded, but our discoveries have not amounted to any conclusive evidence.
say:7:1010210805:1.source_cn: 嗯，洞里虽然味道大了点，但没有危险。弗朗茨和盗匪可能有...

say:8:1010210806:1.text: I see. No wonder the steward of Lord Franz's Manor assured me of everything...
say:8:1010210806:1.source_cn: 原来如此，怪不得此前弗朗茨庄园的管事曾经向我保证过……

say:9:1010210807:1.text: He guaranteed that if I were to acquire Gemvine grapes from Lord Franz, the trade route would be undeterred by incidents such as the bridge malfunctioning or miraculous fires.
say:9:1010210807:1.source_cn: 他说，如果我考虑和弗朗茨合作，收购藤水晶，那么商路绝对...

say:10:1010210808:1.text: Speaking of which, you all probably know that the wheat yields in Northville have declined due to the cold weather.
say:10:1010210808:1.source_cn: 说到这个，我想起另一件事……你们大概知道，北村麦子的产...

say:11:1010210809:1.text: However, grapes tolerate the cold even worse than wheat, so surely the Gemvine grapes would be affected.
say:11:1010210809:1.source_cn: 然而，葡萄的耐寒程度比麦子更差，南村藤水晶的产量应该跌...

say:12:1010210810:1.text: I asked Lord Franz's steward about it, but he just told me not to worry because there would soon be <style="highlight">enough fertile land</style> for a better harvest.
say:12:1010210810:1.source_cn: 我曾经问过弗朗茨的管事，他告诉我不用担心，因为很快就会...

say:13:1010210811:1.text: Perhaps Lord Franz started the fire in order to purchase the wheat fields in Northville at a cheaper price.
say:13:1010210811:1.source_cn: 或许……弗朗茨是为了能低价购入北村的麦田，才有了那场火。

say:14:1010210812:1.text: I see... Do you know why I wanted to come explore this cave?
say:14:1010210812:1.source_cn: 说到这个，你们知道我为什么会来到这个山洞附近调查吗？

choice_prompt:15:1010210812.text: I see... Do you know why I wanted to come explore this cave?
choice_prompt:15:1010210812.source_cn: 说到这个，你们知道我为什么会来到这个山洞附近调查吗？

say:16:1010210813:1.text: Actually, the Heroic Order did receive a report from Southville a long time ago.
say:16:1010210813:1.source_cn: 事实上，很早之前，骑士团曾经接到过一次关于南村的报案。

say:17:1010210814:1.text: A villager mysteriously disappeared. Everyone assumed he'd been killed by wolves or gruglins, but our investigations showed that he happened to be the one person who was most opposed to Lord Franz planting grapes in Southville.
say:17:1010210814:1.source_cn: 有居民神秘失踪，大家怀疑他是被附近的狼或是咕布林袭击了...

say:18:1010210815:1.text: After he disappeared, Lord Franz's grape venture developed quickly. He made a lot of money, and gradually, all opposition in the village vanished.
say:18:1010210815:1.source_cn: 那之后，弗朗茨的葡萄产业就轰轰烈烈地开展起来，挣到了钱...

say:21:1010210816:1.text: As far as I'm concerned, Lord Franz had something to do with the fire in Northville.
say:21:1010210816:1.source_cn: 依我看，那个弗朗茨和北村的火灾逃不开干系。

say:22:1010210817:1.text: We still need to find definitive proof.
say:22:1010210817:1.source_cn: 我们还是得找到更确凿的证据。

say:25:1010210818:1.text: About that... I've arranged to meet Lord Franz later near the vineyard in Southville to discuss our future business venture.
say:25:1010210818:1.source_cn: 关于这点，我先前和弗朗茨约好，待会要在金穗南村的葡萄田...

choice_prompt:26:1010210818.text: About that... I've arranged to meet Lord Franz later near the vineyard in Southville to discuss our future business venture.
choice_prompt:26:1010210818.source_cn: 关于这点，我先前和弗朗茨约好，待会要在金穗南村的葡萄田周围碰面，好商议后续的商业合作。

say:27:1010210819:1.text: As I said before, I just want to open up new trade routes and acquire profitable goods. That's all.
say:27:1010210819:1.source_cn: 像之前说过的，我要打通附近的商路，找到合适的货物，这是...

say:28:1010210820:1.text: So, with us, it can't be a negotiation or even altruism, but...
say:28:1010210820:1.source_cn: 所以，不是交易，也不是帮助，而是——

choice_prompt:29:1010210820.text: So, with us, it can't be a negotiation or even altruism, but...
choice_prompt:29:1010210820.source_cn: 所以，不是交易，也不是帮助，而是——

choice:6:0:1.text: Here's what happened in the cave...
choice:6:0:1.male: Here's what happened in the cave...
choice:6:0:1.female: Here's what happened in the cave...

say:0:1010210901:0.text: Well then, Master Rowan, you go find Lord Franz, and we'll act accordingly.
say:0:1010210901:0.source_cn: 那么，小少爷你先去找弗朗茨，我们见机行事！

say:1:1010210902:0.text: Leave it to me. And safe travels!
say:1:1010210902:0.source_cn: 交给我吧，你们也路上小心。

say:6:1010206004:0.text: Young Master Rowan, I'm sorry for letting these louts disturb you. I'll make them pay!
say:6:1010206004:0.source_cn: 罗万少爷，抱歉让这些刁民打扰了您，我会让他们付出代价！

say:8:1010206006:0.text: I think... these people from Southville... I've seen them somewhere before.
say:8:1010206006:0.source_cn: 我是觉得……南村这些人……之前好像在哪见过？

say:9:1010206007:0.text: How could that be? I'm sure you're just a little confused because you were scared.
say:9:1010206007:0.source_cn: 怎么可能呢？一定是您受到惊吓，产生了错觉。

say:10:1010206008:0.text: You uncivilized rabble! You will pay for this!
say:10:1010206008:0.source_cn: 无礼的平民！这笔账，我们非得算清不可！

narration:22:1010233:0.text: Faced with the threat from Lord Franz's guards, Cassadee uses teleportation magic to whisk everyone away from Southville.
narration:22:1010233:0.source_cn: 迫于弗朗茨手下卫兵的威胁，科丝蒂用传送魔法将大家带离了南村。

say:3:1010207001:0.text: We've arrived! How are you all?
say:3:1010207001:0.source_cn: 到这里就没问题了！各位，你们都还好吗？

say:4:1010207002:0.source_cn: 还、还好……就是晕得慌……还有……

say:6:1010207004:0.text: EWW! Don't vomit on my skirt!
say:6:1010207004:0.source_cn: 呀——！你别吐在我的裙子上！！！

say:7:1010207005:0.text: Wonderful... If it's only vomit, then it's fine.

say:11:1010207007:0.text: Ummm... Lady Mage, are you saying you've seen worse?
say:11:1010207007:0.source_cn: 我说尊敬的魔法师小姐……难道你还见过更糟糕的情况？

say:12:1010207008:0.text: Actually... teleportation magic isn't my strong suit.
say:12:1010207008:0.source_cn: 其实……我不太擅长传送魔法。

say:13:1010207009:0.text: It needs precise positioning, but I don't really know my way around here... so sometimes... there may be small errors.
say:13:1010207009:0.source_cn: 传送魔法需要精准把控方位，但我不太认路……所以偶尔会出...

say:14:1010207010:0.text: Um... If I may be so bold, these "small errors" you mentioned don't include death or decapitation, do they?
say:14:1010207010:0.source_cn: 那个……冒昧问一句，你说的小差错该不会是指整个人失踪吧？

say:16:1010207012:0.text: I've repeatedly verified that, at most, a limb or an internal organ may be lost. But it's all easily fixed if promptly dealt with.
say:16:1010207012:0.source_cn: 我反复验证过，最多会丢失身体的某些小部件。只要及时处理...

say:17:1010207013:0.text: Please tell us about this sort of thing in advance next time!
say:17:1010207013:0.source_cn: 这种事下次要提前说啊！

say:20:1010207014:0.text: Hopefully, there won't be a next time.

say:23:1010207015:0.text: Magister! I bet you know just the thing to treat the side effects of teleportation magic, don't you?
say:23:1010207015:0.source_cn: 主人！你一定有办法治疗传送魔法带来的副作用，对不对？
say:23:1010207015:0.male: Magister! I bet you know just the thing to treat the side effects of teleportation magic, don't you?
say:23:1010207015:0.female: Magister! I bet you know just the thing to treat the side effects of teleportation magic, don't you?

choice_prompt:24:1010207015.text: Magister! I bet you know just the thing to treat the side effects of teleportation magic, don't you?
choice_prompt:24:1010207015.source_cn: 主人！你一定有办法治疗传送魔法带来的副作用，对不对？
choice_prompt:24:1010207015.male: Magister! I bet you know just the thing to treat the side effects of teleportation magic, don't you?
choice_prompt:24:1010207015.female: Magister! I bet you know just the thing to treat the side effects of teleportation magic, don't you?

say:25:1010207016:0.text: There are lots of herbs nearby. They can be made into medicine that can make everyone feel better.
say:25:1010207016:0.source_cn: 这附近有不少药草，用它们熬制出药汤，能够缓解大家的症状。

say:26:1010207017:0.text: Just leave the others to me, Magister. I'll keep an eye on them while you go gather the herbs.
say:26:1010207017:0.source_cn: 那么主人，在你熬好药草之前，先由我来照顾大家吧。
say:26:1010207017:0.male: Just leave the others to me, Magister. I'll keep an eye on them while you go gather the herbs.
say:26:1010207017:0.female: Just leave the others to me, Magister. I'll keep an eye on them while you go gather the herbs.

say:28:1010207018:0.text: Okay, let me prepare some food. Everyone just relax and rest. You'll feel better in no time.
say:28:1010207018:0.source_cn: 我会为大家准备食物，大家稍作歇息，很快又能恢复精神啦。

say:29:1010207019:0.text: Magister, I just remembered that there are lots of herbs nearby! They can be made into medicine that can make everyone feel better.
say:29:1010207019:0.source_cn: 对了主人，附近应该有不少药草，用它们熬制出药汤，能够缓...
say:29:1010207019:0.male: Magister, I just remembered that there are lots of herbs nearby! They can be made into medicine that can make everyone feel better.
say:29:1010207019:0.female: Magister, I just remembered that there are lots of herbs nearby! They can be made into medicine that can make everyone feel better.

say:30:1010207020:0.text: I know that as long as you're with us, everything will be alright.
say:30:1010207020:0.source_cn: 请放心，只要有主人在，绝对不会有事的！
say:30:1010207020:0.male: I know that as long as you're with us, everything will be alright.
say:30:1010207020:0.female: I know that as long as you're with us, everything will be alright.

choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 建议大家找个地方休息

subtitle:1:1011087001:.text: And this beautiful field is the work of Archmage Merlin.
subtitle:1:1011087001:.source_cn: 请看这漂亮的田地，多亏了大魔法师梅林
subtitle:1:1011087001:.male: And this beautiful field is the work of Archmage Merlin.
subtitle:1:1011087001:.female: And this beautiful field is the work of Archmage Merlin.

subtitle:1:1011087002:.text: He once cast a protective spell here, so our crops thrived.
subtitle:1:1011087002:.source_cn: <male>他</male><female>她</female>曾在此施展加护，作物才能茁壮成长
subtitle:1:1011087002:.male: He once cast a protective spell here, so our crops thrived.
subtitle:1:1011087002:.female: She once cast a protective spell here, so our crops thrived.

subtitle:1:1011087003:.text: So this place is under Merlin's protection?
subtitle:1:1011087003:.source_cn: 这里真的有梅林的加护？
subtitle:1:1011087003:.male: So this place is under Merlin's protection?
subtitle:1:1011087003:.female: So this place is under Merlin's protection?

subtitle:1:1011087005:.source_cn: 诡异的气息四处弥散，究竟是为什么呢？

subtitle:1:1011087006:.source_cn: 总之，这不可能是<style="highlight">梅林的魔法</style>

subtitle:1:1011087011:.source_cn: 这些咕布林……它们发疯了！
